> Sigma has confirmed it is developing the 85mm F1.2 DG | Art, a large-aperture medium-telephoto prime for full-frame mirrorless cameras that completes its trio of fast F1.2 Art lenses. Coming to L-Mount and Sony E-mount, it joins the 35mm F1.2 DG II | Art and 50mm F1.2 DG DN | Art — and Sigma says this rounds out its F1.2 line-up, so no further focal lengths are planned at this aperture.
